A '''war''' was fought between the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Esh-kha]], a violent species that had begun to wreak havoc across a swath of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Esh-kha's attacks on [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] worlds of the Infinite Empire attracted the attention of the Rakata, who nearly wiped out the Esh-kha in the resultant conflict. The surviving Esh-kha were ultimately imprisoned on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. A monument to the conflict was placed on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which described the punishment of the Esh-kha.
